# McpFn

> Build, secure, test, and evolve Model Context Protocol servers with stable consumer contracts.

## Documentation

- [Authorization](/docs/authorization) — Protect Streamable HTTP, complete client OAuth, and compose hosted authorization.
- [Connect a client](/docs/client) — Production stdio and Streamable HTTP sessions, inventories, calls, and OAuth completion.
- [Deployment](/docs/deployment) — Run McpFn over HTTP on Node or Cloudflare Workers and keep the transport boundary secure.
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Install McpFn, declare a validated tool, and run a server.
- [McpFn documentation](/docs) — Consumer guide to building, connecting to, securing, and testing MCP servers.
- [Migrate or adopt incrementally](/docs/migration) — Move a custom MCP server to McpFn or test it without changing its runtime.
- [Architecture](/docs/reference/architecture) — Source-aligned McpFn architecture documentation.
- [Authorization](/docs/reference/auth) — Source-aligned McpFn authorization documentation.
- [CLI](/docs/reference/cli) — Source-aligned McpFn cli documentation.
- [Client](/docs/reference/client) — Source-aligned McpFn client documentation.
- [Core runtime](/docs/reference/core) — Source-aligned McpFn core runtime documentation.
- [DataFn adapter](/docs/reference/datafn) — Source-aligned McpFn datafn adapter documentation.
- [Package reference](/docs/reference) — Source-aligned package documentation and implementation architecture.
- [Inspector](/docs/reference/inspector) — Source-aligned McpFn inspector documentation.
- [Testing and CI](/docs/reference/testing-and-ci) — Source-aligned McpFn testing and ci documentation.
- [Testing API](/docs/reference/testing) — Source-aligned McpFn testing api documentation.
- [Build a server](/docs/server) — Registry, context, profiles, resources, prompts, tasks, and transports.
- [Test and evolve a server](/docs/testing) — Manifests, client profiles, semantic scenarios, authentication, and protocol conformance.
